title: Strategic Business Development Manager, U.S. Nuclear at Tetra Tech Expects Consolidation Among Advanced Reactor Developers
expert: Strategic business development manager, U.S. nuclear, at Tetra Tech (current; ~16 years in power and nuclear)
verdict: A Tetra Tech nuclear BD manager ranks GE Vernova's 300 MW BWRX-300 the SMR frontrunner but sees no major plant purchase orders yet, long-lead equipment at 4 to 5 years and commercial construction only from 2029–2030.

Competition & share: 🟢 BWRX-300 and AP1000 the likely frontrunners; only 10 of roughly 50 advanced-reactor efforts survive the next 2–4 years (estimate), consistent with the ex-GE Hitachi engineer ranking BWRX-300 first (2026-11-06 call).
GW contract adds cadence: 🔴 No major nuclear purchase orders; commercial construction 2029–2030, generation 2030–2032 (estimate) vs ex-GE Hitachi engineer's construction in less than four years (2026-11-06 call): later. → Tenet 4 (hyperscaler broadening) →
Big-3 supply response: 🟢 Long-lead nuclear equipment 4 to 5 years; workforce averages 55–60 (first-hand), in line with GEV gas-turbine lead times of 5.0 years (SB #63265). → Tenet 2 (industry supply short) ↑

characterization_changed: Positive: the expert is slightly more pessimistic on nuclear, with no major plant purchase orders and commercial construction not before 2029–2030; GEV's frontrunner status is opinion.
changes: Commercial nuclear construction 2029–2030 (estimate) vs ex-GE Hitachi engineer's BWRX-300 construction in less than four years (2026-11-06 call): later timeline.
BWRX-300 ranked frontrunner vs the same ranking in the 2026-11-06 call and TVA Clinch River construction permit (SB #59084, 2026-09-29): consistent.
Long-lead nuclear equipment 4 to 5 years vs GEV gas-turbine lead times 5.0 years (SB #63265, 2026-10-16): similar tightness across power equipment.
thesis_impact: Tenet 2 (industry supply short through the decade): ↑ — long-lead nuclear equipment 4 to 5 years; workforce averaging 55–60.
Tenet 4 (hyperscaler demand broadening): → — no major nuclear orders yet; construction starts 2029–2030 (estimate).
